description: Send an email immediately. This cannot be undone. Attachments that do not fit the ~3 MB inline budget (up to 150 MB each) are uploaded in chunks first; if an upload fails nothing is sent.

attachments.description: Local files inside OUTLOOK_ATTACH_DIRS (default: download dir, ~/Documents, ~/Desktop); hidden files are refused. Up to 150 MB each; files that do not fit the ~3 MB inline budget go through an upload session

from.description: From address: must be the signed-in mailbox or one of its aliases / SendAs identities

fromName.description: Display name shown with the From address (e.g. Fox); requires from. Outlook.com may replace it with the account name when from is the primary address

name: send_mail
